description: This Java class 'StartupFrame' manages the startup UI for selecting serial or TCP ports, launching firmware flashing, and starting the main application launcher for rusEfi console.

classes.name: StartupFrame
classes.description: Main class for startup UI, port selection, and launching firmware flashing or main application.

methods.name: StartupFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializing the startup window, setting up port scanning and UI.

methods.name: setAppIcon
methods.description: Sets the application icon for the JFrame.

methods.name: chooseSerialPort
methods.description: Builds and displays the port selection UI, including buttons for connecting, flashing firmware, and starting the simulator.

methods.name: installMessage
methods.description: Sets tooltip text for a UI component.

methods.name: findAndApplyPorts
methods.description: Detects available serial/TCP ports and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: findAllAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list of all available serial and TCP ports.

methods.name: disposeFrameAndProceed
methods.description: Closes the startup window and stops port scanning.

methods.name: addPortSelection
methods.description: Populates the port selection combo box with detected ports.

methods.name: createSpeedCombo
methods.description: Creates a combo box for selecting baud rate speeds.
